problems: Channel logic reuses the CASE from public.london_daily_covers_base (read this run via pg_get_viewdef): 'web' = Booking Widget, any '%landing page%', Nav CTA, Hero CTA, Menu Page, Website, 'PPC%', popup, edm; 'gr' = Google Reserve Integration; 'walk' = Walk In; 'recep' = '%reception%' or DSL Host, plus 'Reservation Team' / 'Reservations Team' (the USA reservations desks, which the view's two-capitalised-words staff regex would otherwise swallow). The 'ot' slot is the USA platform: Open Table, OpenTable, OTGC, OT Guestcenter, OT and Resy. 'tp' holds the partner sources DoorDash, Bilt Integration and Flaming Duck Miami. Filters: is_deleted = false, status_simple <> 'Canceled', venue_seating_area_name NOT ILIKE '%bar%', metric SUM(covers) by booking-created date ((sr_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date), sargable range predicates on sr_created_at.

Staff-name booking sources are EXCLUDED from the covers total entirely, as in prior weeks: the view's two-capitalised-words regex with its keyword exclusion list, plus the lower-case and single-name USA staff entries ('andrew sicklin', 'Luz', 'Lucilly', 'Tracey', 'Wendy') and 'Imported Reservations'. 'Flaming Duck Miami' matches the staff regex but is a partner source, so it is forced into 'tp'.

VALIDATION: 21 to 27 Sep recomputed with this SQL returns Aqua NYC 1,773 (published 1,811, -2.1%), Hutong NYC 1,572 (1,609, -2.3%), Hutong Miami 620 (624, -0.6%), market 3,965 vs 4,044 published (-2.0%). All of the gap is bookings made in that week and cancelled since. The OpenTable and Resy line reproduces last week's published series to the cover on W32, W33 and W34 and within 0.3% on W35 to W37, so the classification is stable.

BULK IMPORT EXCLUDED FROM THE CURRENT WEEK: Hutong New York took 40 'OT Guestcenter' records / 124 covers created 2026-09-29 00:00 UTC (28 Sep 20:00 New York), 100 percent past-dated at creation with service dates 19 Mar to 27 Sep 2026. Hutong NYC 'ot' reads 424 without it and 548 with it; the market total reads 3,715 without and 3,839 with. No other hour in the week carried eight or more past-dated records, so nothing else was excluded. The year-ago week was checked the same way and carries no history load: its largest OT Guestcenter hour is 24 records with 16 past-dated spanning 24 Sep to 20 Oct 2025, which is ordinary late and forward syncing.

EARLIER IMPORTS ALSO EXCLUDED, as last week: Hutong New York 76 records / 211 covers created 2026-09-21 21:00 UTC and 25 records / 75 covers created 2026-09-23 20:00 UTC (both affect the prior-week column and the W38 point), Aqua Roma 105 records / 273 covers created 2026-09-15 02:00 UTC (W37 point), and Hutong New York 685 records / 1,907 covers created 2026-09-04 22:00 UTC (W35 point). The Aqua Roma onboarding load of 2025-09-23 16:00 UTC is outside this week's year-ago window (29 Sep to 5 Oct 2025) so it has no effect here.

GAP, NOT ZERO, carried from last week: Hutong Miami's 'Lucilly' bookings are treated as staff by this logic and so fall outside the seven reported channels, which is why Miami reception reads 0. Lucilly accounted for 24 records / 83 covers across 21 Sep to 4 Oct. Miami also has 'Luz' (10 / 44), 'Hayley', 'Maibe' and 'Damarys' on the same footing. Put back, Miami's reception line would be materially non-zero; the treatment is unchanged from last week so the series stays comparable.

OUTSIDE THE SEVEN CHANNELS this week ('other' in this file, excluded from the covers total): Hutong New York 18 covers, of which 3 records / 7 covers carried booking_source 'Booking widget' with a lower-case w, which the view's case-sensitive exact match on 'Booking Widget' does not catch; Hutong Miami 14 covers from the single first names 'Hayley', 'Maibe ' and 'Damarys'; Aqua Roma 2 covers from 'Ten Group', a concierge partner the staff regex releases because of its 'group' keyword but which is in no partner list. Prior week 'other' was 0 at all three venues, year-ago week was 19 / 31 / 9. These are recorded rather than reclassified so the week-on-week series stays on one definition.
